name: Jinchuuriki Source — PDF p. 22
content:
Jinchuuriki — Original translated source, PDF page 22

Left column

HIJUTSUS

  JINCHUURIKI (POWER OF HUMAN SACRIFICE)

                                  Restricted Power

Reach: Personal
Action: Partial (see text)                 Duration: Continuous (see text)
Type: Ninjutsu                        Subtype: Kinjutsu
Hand seals: No

Jinchuuriki is the title given to a ninja who has a Bijuu (Tailed Beast) sealed within
their body. Every Tailed Beast provides its user with a reserve of chakra and raw
power, as well as special abilities that depend on the type of beast. This power works
based on active benefits, acquired through continuous use, as well as passive
benefits, acquired through its natural evolution.


Benefits Table: Each Bijuu is different and therefore has its own list of benefits. You
will automatically receive the benefits listed in the table as your power level increases.


Some Bijuu, like Shukaku (Ichibi), still possess the effects of an elemental power
mixed within the Jinchuuriki power. The elemental power also follows the benefit
table: you are only entitled to choose effects for the power at the levels specified by
the table.

The following rules are general for all types of Jinchuuriki. And at the end are the
specific benefits that the Kyuubi grants. To learn about the benefits of the other bijuu,
see the Book of Hijutsus.

Modes and Techniques: This power has modes of use and techniques. The modes
of the power (such as the Bijuu Cloak) have variable prerequisites depending on the
Bijuu.

                                                   2

Right column

Jinchuuriki for Players

   The life of a Jinchuuriki is not easy. Besides the emotional issues related to living
    with the Bijuu itself, they also have to deal with the typically harsh treatment from
     their village, since every Jinchuuriki is seen as a potential or primary military force of
    the village.
    Sometimes, even other villages and criminal organizations try to capture the Jinchuuriki to
     extract their Bijuu. The Game Master can (and should) explore this within the story!


    Techniques (like the Bijuudama) have fixed prerequisites, but they can also depend
     in some way on the Jinchuuriki's power. It is not possible to use technique abilities
    with any of the general Jinchuuriki power techniques.


   Usage: Using Bijuu Presence is a free action, and using any other power mode is a
     partial action, but requires the previous level mode to already be active. Returning to
    any lower power mode is a free action.


    Thus, using the Bijuu Cloak is a partial action, and using Bijuu Mode (which is the
    subsequent mode) is also a partial action, but you must already have the Bijuu Cloak
    active (remember that if you have already consumed your partial action this turn, you
    can convert the movement action into a partial action to use Bijuu Mode; see more in
   Combat Actions, p.
   253 of the Basic Book).

    Unless the text states otherwise, the benefits of each mode of power are not
    cumulative, as only one mode can be used.

     one at a time.

   Chakra Cost: Power modes do not consume chakra. However, their use depletes
    the user's body, causing damage to their Vitality.


2

name: Jinchuuriki Source — PDF p. 23
content:
Jinchuuriki — Original translated source, PDF page 23

Left column

Techniques can be used by expending chakra or paying with Vitality points. The costs of the
techniques are in their descriptions.

Damage to Vitality: This is equal to the level of power used. The damage is suffered at the
moment of activation of the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode and at the beginning of each
subsequent turn. Using the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode causes damage to the Jinchuuriki's
body: in addition to having harmful chakra, the Bijuu always tries to take advantage of any
opportunity to break the seal and break free. You do not suffer damage when using Bijuu
Presence or Bijuu Form (provided it is not a forced transformation; see more below).


Safe Duration: 1 turn +1 per power level. This is the amount of time you can use the power
without losing control over the Bijuu during the scene. After this time, the Bijuu begins to
further tighten the seal: damage to Vitality is doubled, and even using Bijuu Presence causes
damage to the character.

Bijuu's Fact Sheet

If you need to create a Bijuu character sheet, you can follow these parameters.


Every Bijuu has a NC of 20. Distribute Attribute points using the normal rules for characters
and apply size modifiers. Do not purchase Skills (use the full Attribute level if you need to
make Skill checks).


The Bijuu has no abilities and possesses only one power, which is precisely the Jinchuuriki
level 10 power. However, it can only use the Bijuu Form (permanent duration) and the
techniques permitted by the form.

The Bijuu possesses infinite Vitality and Chakra. The only way to truly defeat it is by sealing it
within a person or special object created for this purpose.



                                                    2

Right column

Mastery Test: When your Vitality reaches zero while using the power, or when you experience
     strong emotional stress (at the Master's discretion), you must perform a Mastery Test to keep
     the Bijuu under control.


    The mastery test is not precise: you roll 2 dice against a difficulty of 9. If you fail, you will
    undergo a forced transformation into Bijuu Mode, releasing a tail, and enter a mental struggle
     to remain conscious, but with temporary control over the Bijuu.


    At the start of each subsequent turn, you must make a new mastery test with +1 difficulty
     level, for three turns. If you fail 2 tests, you will completely lose consciousness and be treated
    as an NPC, being dominated by the Bijuu and attacking everything and everyone within your
     reach. Each turn the transformation will progress so that the jinchuuriki's appearance becomes
     increasingly similar to that of their Bijuu (the pace of this transformation is at the GM's
     discretion). When the transformation is complete, the character will die, leaving the beast free
      in the world.



        If you pass the tests, the transformation is contained, reverting completely. The power is
     deactivated, and you will be exhausted for the rest of the day, unable to use it again until you
     rest. If you try, you will initiate a forced transformation, automatically failing all mastery tests.



    Jinchuuriki Death: If you die from losing control of the Tailed Beast, it is released. If you die
    from any other cause, the Bijuu's chakra disperses throughout the world, remaining so for an
     indefinite period until it rejoins, when the Bijuu is reborn free.


    Total Control: When a Jinchuuriki reaches a certain power level, according to the Bijuu's
    power chart, they gain total control and synergy with the tailed beast.


3

name: Jinchuuriki Source — PDF p. 24
content:
Jinchuuriki — Original translated source, PDF page 24

Left column

With full control, the user suffers no damage to their vitality when using any mode of the
power. Instead, using the power costs chakra equal to their Jinchuuriki power level, paid only
once while maintaining the power active, with no further chakra costs for switching between
modes.


The safe duration rule also ceases to exist, and the Jinchuuriki can use the
power freely throughout the scene without penalty. Conversely, it is no longer
possible to pay the cost of techniques using this power with Vitality.


Furthermore, if the Jinchuuriki allows it, the Bijuu can speak through them
when in Bijuu Form.

The Game Master can delay the granting of Full Control, or even place
conditions on it (such as developing a true friendship with the Bijuu), if they
deem it coherent and necessary for the campaign.

Releasing Genjutsu: When the user with Full Control is trapped in a genjutsu,
the Bijuu can use its own chakra to employ the Kai technique, freeing it from
the illusion. Since the chakra of a tailed beast is much stronger than human
chakra, the Kai technique is an automatic success. Doing this costs the
character no actions and can only be done at the beginning of the jinchuuriki's
second turn while under the illusion's effect.


             MODES OF POWER

BIJUU PRESENCE
ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 2

The power of the bijuu begins to manifest in the character, who may undergo
minor changes in appearance, such as a change in iris pattern or style.

                                                      24

Right column

The color of the wielded bijuu, in addition to a subtle change in behavior, which becomes
    more animalistic.

    Benefits: The character receives +1 Strength, and unarmed attacks deal lethal
   damage. You also gain access to the Beast's Might benefit (see page 26).


   BIJUU CLOAK
    ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 3

   The character begins to gain control over the bijuu's chakra, which appears
   around them as a chakra aura similar in shape to the bijuu being wielded.
    Normally, the cloak has a single tail in its shape, and more tails appear as the
    user increases their power.


     Benefits: When using the Bijuu Cloak, unarmed attacks now cause lethal damage. The
     character gains Body Hardness 1 and becomes able to block projectile-type techniques. They
     also become accelerated and receive Strength bonuses that vary according to the level of the
    power used, limited by the number of Bijuu tails (the Strength bonus is not cumulative). Note
     that, although it is a Level 3 technique of the power, you can use it at Level 2 if you only want
     to receive the benefit of one tail.

content:
Jinchuuriki — Original translated source, PDF page 25

Left column

BIJUU MODE

ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level varies depending on the Bijuu

The bijuu mode is the character's boundary between humanoid and feral appearance.
The bijuu cloak has its appearance altered, with the blood from the character's wounds
mixing with chakra, giving it a deep, opaque crimson color. In behavior, the user
resembles a beast more than a human.


Benefits: When using Bijuu Mode, you retain the benefits of the Cloak and also receive
+2 Agility and +1 Body Hardness (total Body Hardness 2).


Restriction of Techniques: Conversely, you become unable to perform hand seals.
You also become unable to use any power or technique that is not a general technique
of this power.

BIJUU FORM

ÿ Prerequisite: Total Control; Jinchuuriki level varies depending on the Bijuu

At the peak of their control over the Bijuu, the jinchuuriki is able to fully transform into their
tailed beast: the chakra condenses and envelops the user, who increases in size frighteningly
and takes on the complete form of the Bijuu, as if they were the Bijuu itself.


Size: The character increases their size to Huge, receiving the benefits and penalties
of that category. At power level 8, it increases to Huge. At level 10, to Colossal.


Benefits: The character retains the benefits of the Cloak and Bijuu Mode and receives
+1 Body Hardness (total Body Hardness 3). In return, they lose the Agility bonus and
the Accelerated condition.
Due to the increase in size, it will also be unable to use the Chakra Arm, as its
condensed energy will take on a physical form.

                                                  2

Right column

The Chakra Wave, Chakra Blast, and Bijuudama techniques receive a +2 damage
    bonus and the benefits of the Powerful Technique skill. The Bijuudama's cylinder blast
    gains +10m in diameter. The Bijuudama's remaining damage becomes level 2, but only
        if your attack roll had a damage level of 2 or higher.


    Restriction of Techniques: You become unable to use any power or technique that is
    not a general technique of this power, or that is not a special technique or power
    permitted by the rules of the Bijuu itself (Matatabi, for example, can use its special
    Katon by expelling flames from its mouth!).


   Power of the Greater Beast: you receive bonus damage to the Power of the
    Beast equals 1/2 of the Bijuu Cloak Strength bonus per number of tails.



   PARTIAL TRANSFORMATION

    ÿ Ninjutsu /Kinjutsu
    ÿ Prerequisite: Bijuu Form
    ÿ Action: Free (see description)
    ÿ Range: 5 m
    ÿ Duration: Sustained
    ÿ Chakra Cost: Half the power level (see description)

    This transformation must be used with the Bijuu Presence active and cannot be used
    with other modes of power. The jinchuuriki with full control over the Beast can perform
     partial transformations, making a single arm or tail of the Bijuu appear, without needing
     to assume its complete form.


   The created arm or tail follows the same rules as the Chakra Arm (page 27), with the
     following differences:

           GENERAL BENEFITS AND TECHNIQUES


CHAKRA BIJUU

ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 1
Action : None
ÿ Scope: Personal
ÿ Duration: Permanent

You gain the benefits of the Expanded Chakra aptitude (see Uzumaki clan) for free.
This chakra is a separate reserve within your body, as the bijuu's chakra does not pass
through the same chakra circulation as the Jinchuuriki's.


In practice, this means that your Expanded Chakra benefit cannot be drained or sealed
by the enemy, in any way whatsoever. This chakra can only be drained if it is already
outside your body through the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode. In either case, a living
creature that drains bijuu chakra, in any quantity, suffers fixed damage equal to the
power level.


POWER OF THE BEAST

ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 2
Action : None
ÿ Scope: Personal
ÿ Duration: Continuous


                                                               26

Right column

To benefit from the Might of the Beast, you need to have one of the power modes
     active (any one).

     Instead of using the Strength attribute to attack, the jinchuuriki can use bijuu chakra in
     their strikes. Attacking with the Beast's Power causes lethal damage and has a different
     calculation, necessarily using the Spirit attribute.

    according to the level of power:

content:

Left column

A powerful shockwave surrounds it, in the shape of a hemisphere or circle with its center
on itself.

Those hit by the wave suffer base damage equal to 2x Power Level and must test
Stamina (Difficulty 7 + 2x Power Level) or be pushed to the edge of the area of effect. If
you have level 8 in the power, in addition to being pushed, the victim will fall prone.



CHAKRA ARM

ÿ Ninjutsu /Kinjutsu; Chakra Control
ÿ Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 4, Bijuu Cloak
Action : Partial (see description)
ÿ Scope: Personal
ÿ Duration: Sustained
ÿ Chakra/Vitality Cost: Power level (see description)

To use this technique, you must have the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode active. Using the
beast's chakra, the jinchuuriki creates an energy arm as an extension of their cloak.
Capable of adopting any shape, making curves, and even traveling through the earth,
the arm attacks enemies with immense force. Its appearance resembles a giant claw.



Creation: With a partial action and paying the Chakra/Vitality cost, you can create a
single arm (to create more than one chakra arm, see below). You can collect the created
arms with a free action and recover the chakra points spent. If you create the arm by
paying with Vitality, the cost is not recovered.



Usage: With it, it is possible to perform all the actions that a normal arm would
be capable of (attacking, blocking, holding objects, grabbing enemies...), everything.


                                                   2

Right column

Using the Hand-to-Hand Combat skill. The Finesse aptitude applies to the Chakra Arm.


   The Chakra Arm can be used in a defensive Blocking reaction against armed attacks
    and projectile-type techniques (such as Cannon and Arrow effects). It cannot be used to
    wield weapons, nor can it be used to execute techniques or powers.


   You can create and use the chakra arm even if you are impaired, defenseless , or
    paralyzed, as long as you are conscious, already have the Bijuu Cloak or Bijuu Mode
     active before being restricted by the condition, and can use your chakra freely.


   Ranged Attack: When attacking or performing a special maneuver with the Chakra Arm,
    you can extend it as a free action to hit distant targets up to a maximum of 10m + 4m
    per power level.
    This attack is also performed with a CC test. The arm remains extended if used to
    maintain the grab maneuver; otherwise, it is retracted at the end of the attack.


   Damage: The base damage of the arm is equal to that of an unarmed melee attack by
    the character, with or without Beast Potency, including any combat aptitude that
    increases it (such as Extra Damage).

    Attribute and Skill Tests: If you need to perform any attribute or skill test for the Chakra
    Arm, you can use a precision value equal to 2x the Power Level.


    Maneuvers: The jinchuuriki is capable of performing the feint, grab, takedown , and
    push maneuvers without accuracy penalty. You still cannot use maneuver abilities like
    Throw.

    Maintaining a grip on a target requires concentration. The other rules of the grip
    maneuver remain the same.

While maintaining the maneuver, you can use a free action to tighten your grip on
the victim's body. Doing so is a Strength check resisted by the victim's Stamina. If

exceeded, it will be destroyed.

Pursuit: When used to attack a target 5m or more away, the chakra arm can
pursue it, even underground. You can repeat a failed attack roll, ignoring cover
and bypassing barriers if both already existed before the attack.



Pull: With a movement action, the user can pull a target that is being grabbed by the chakra
arm closer to them. If the target is able to hold on and avoid being pulled, they are entitled to
a resisted Strength vs. Strength test. The user can also use this maneuver to grab a fixed
object and pull themselves to move to its location.



Increased Number: It is possible to create a greater number of arms to strike multiple
targets with a full action, always targeting different targets. The character must double the
chakra cost and can create additional arms up to a number equal to their power level. You
cannot use special maneuvers with the increased number.



Size Increase: It is possible to infuse a larger amount of chakra into a single arm
to increase its size, which is useful for using special maneuvers against larger
enemies or blocking their attacks. The character must spend 2 additional chakra,
and the arm will then acquire the Huge size.

   To use this technique, you must be in Bijuu Mode or Bijuu Form. This technique
    consists of firing a sphere of pure chakra that explodes upon contact with its target.


    Unlike the Bijuudama, which uses the nature chakra in the environment for a
    massive explosion, the Chakra Blast uses the chakra of the tailed beast itself, the
   same chakra that constitutes Bijuu Mode. The technique has two types of use.


    Single Shot: The user fires a single chakra shot as a standard action. At the point
    of impact, a sphere-shaped explosion is created (2m in diameter per level of power
    used). Everyone within the explosion's area, and the direct target of the shot, will
    suffer base damage equal to 2x the level of power used.


    Burst Shot: The user fires a machine gun of chakra projectiles in a straight line at
   a single target. Requires a full action and costs +3 chakra points.


      Initially, the technique deals the same damage as the Single Shot. If the attack is
    successful, make a new hit test for every 2 power levels, and increase the
    technique's damage by +2 for each success. The damage level used is always
    that of the first attack.

BIJUUDAMA
ÿ Ninjutsu /Kinjutsu; Chakra Control
ÿ Prerequisites: Jinchuuriki level 7, Bijuu Mode ÿ
Action: Complete
ÿ Range: Long (15m + 6m per power level)
ÿ Area of Effect: Sphere with a diameter of 6m per power level
ÿ Duration: Instantaneous
ÿ Chakra/Vitality Cost: 1/2 of the Bijuudama's Damage

To use this technique, the character needs to be in Bijuu Mode or Bijuu Form. The Bijuudama
is a sphere made of positive black chakra and positive white chakra, in an 8:2 ratio, requiring
the user to balance the chakra and mold it into a sphere. The technique has two types of
use.


Sphere Shot: The energy sphere will travel its entire range, exploding upon
impact with its target. It suffers a premature explosion if it collides with very
hard obstacles, such as a boulder or a stone barrier, but it swallows and
ignores smaller or less resistant obstacles, such as trees and tall vegetation.


Cylinder Shot: The burst travels the entire range, having a diameter of approximately 5m. It
damages any obstacle in its path and, if it overcomes its hardness, continues to its maximum
range, hitting everyone in the line of effect.


Firing Zone: Preparing and controlling the chakra balance of the Bijuudama
is difficult. Therefore, you need at least 5m of distance from any enemy to use
it. If you do not respect this limit, you lose concentration and the technique
fails (the action and costs paid are not recovered).


Damage: Regardless of the option chosen, the bijuudama will deal base damage
equal to 3x the Power Level used. Its chakra cost is equal to 1/2 of the Power Level used.

                                                    2

Right column

Base damage (any damage bonuses are disregarded when determining the
    cost).

    Anyone who defends against the Bijuudama using Dodge or the Anticipate maneuver, even
        if successful, must make an Agility test (difficulty 9 + 2x Power Level). If they fail, they suffer
   damage from the power with a degree of 1 remaining damage. Accelerated enemies
     automatically succeed on this test.


                    ICHIBI (ONE TAIL)

   Shukaku is the Ichibi, the One-Tailed Beast. Its appearance is that of a tanuki.
   (Japanese raccoon dog) sand-brown in color, with dark blue markings all
    over its body that resemble cursed seals.

      It has an irregular, concave mouth, without a tongue. Its eyes have black
    sclera, with yellow irises and pupils that resemble a black four-pointed star.


    Shukaku has a childish and grumpy personality, and often speaks incoherently, as if he were
    drunk. He uses "ore-sama" (my esteemed self) when referring to himself, as he expresses
     great pride in his own abilities, especially his defense and sealing techniques.



   Shukaku harbors a bitter grudge against Kurama due to the fox's belief that
    the strength of the bijuu is measured by the number of tails, therefore viewing
     Ichibi as the weakest.

   Shukaku's most notable ability is its manipulation of sand, using it as an
    effective weapon and shield. It is capable of performing fuuinjutsu by
    transferring its natural cursed seal markings to its sand techniques. It also
   possesses abilities in manipulating the fuuton element.

In Bijuu Form, you are able to use Sabaku Hijutsu techniques without the need

  SABAKU HIJUTSU (SECRET DESERT TECHNIQUE)

Prerequisite: Jinchuuriki level 1

Sabaku Hijutsu is the manipulation of sand for the purpose of using ninjutsu.
Sand is a very versatile material, useful both offensively and defensively. It is
also abundant, since it is possible to infuse chakra into the ground and alter its
rigidity to produce as much sand as needed for the techniques.


You should treat Sabaku Hijutsu as a variation of the Ninpou power, following
its rules, but with its effects distributed within the Jinchuuriki power and using
this same power as a level parameter. If you wish, you can purchase the
Sabaku Hijutsu power separately to gain additional effects, according to the
rules of the Ninpou power.


Action: Using Sabaku Hijutsu depends on the environment. If you are in a
desert, all effects have their normal action time. Using it on solid ground requires
an additional movement action to produce sand from the earth (this movement
action must always be used before any effect, and you can always create the
amount of sand needed to perform the technique). Using it on the high seas is
impossible (unless you have the Special Sand effect).

Range: Medium (10m + 2m per Spirit level). The character can only manipulate

SPECIAL SAND

Action : Reaction
